_adr_diagrams: Edges for the new diagrams package (MermaidDiagramVisualizations.md #1). api -> diagrams: routes_diagrams.py exposes the IR pipeline. diagrams -> core: config_loader only, for the mermaid_elk flag (read fail-closed). diagrams -> llm: constrained.extract_json, to coerce a planner payload offline. diagrams -> response_arch: structured.generate_structured, the ONE model seam (planner + critic) so schema-validated generation is not reimplemented. Deliberately absent: diagrams imports no chat/orchestration/agent package, so the compiler stays usable from any caller. response_arch -> diagrams: `response_arch.layer.finalize` calls the answer-path compile lane (diagrams/lane.py), so every model-written mermaid fence is recompiled from its parsed structure. The direction is deliberate: response_arch (answer shaping) depends on diagrams (the artifact compiler), never the reverse — the compiler stays usable from a route, a document generator or a test with no response-shaping context. The one reverse edge, diagrams -> response_arch, is confined to structured.generate_structured in planner/critic.
